    // TIGHT: the half-extent along a world axis is the sum of the three local
    // half-extents weighted by the absolute components of the rotated local axes —
    // the box's support function evaluated on that axis.
    Bounds(b: Box3D): Bounds3D
    {
        var f = b.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var hx = b.Size.Width * 0.5;
        var hy = b.Size.Height * 0.5;
        var hz = b.Size.Depth * 0.5;
        return CenteredBounds(b.Center,
            hx * f.X.X.Abs + hy * f.Y.X.Abs + hz * f.Z.X.Abs,
            hx * f.X.Y.Abs + hy * f.Y.Y.Abs + hz * f.Z.Y.Abs,
            hx * f.X.Z.Abs + hy * f.Y.Z.Abs + hz * f.Z.Z.Abs);
    }
```

    // TIGHT: the axial half-extent (h/2)|axis.e| plus the cap disk's own extent
    // r*sqrt(1 - (axis.e)^2) on each world axis e.
    Bounds(c: Cylinder): Bounds3D
    {
        var a = c.Axis.Vector;
        var disk = DiskHalfExtents(a, c.Radius);
        var half = c.Height * 0.5;
        return CenteredBounds(c.Center,
            half * a.X.Abs + disk.X,
            half * a.Y.Abs + disk.Y,
            half * a.Z.Abs + disk.Z);
    }
```

    Bounds(s: CylindricalShell): Bounds3D

    // TIGHT: the support of the ellipsoid along a world axis is
    // sqrt(sum over local axes of (semiAxis * axisImage.component)^2), because the
    // ellipsoid is the unit ball mapped by the (rotated, scaled) semi-axis frame.
    Bounds(e: Ellipsoid): Bounds3D
    {
        var b = e.Orientation.Basis3D;
        var a = e.SemiAxes;
        var ex = ((a.X * b.X.X).Square + (a.Y * b.Y.X).Square + (a.Z * b.Z.X).Square).Sqrt;
        var ey = ((a.X * b.X.Y).Square + (a.Y * b.Y.Y).Square + (a.Z * b.Z.Y).Square).Sqrt;
        var ez = ((a.X * b.X.Z).Square + (a.Y * b.Y.Z).Square + (a.Z * b.Z.Z).Square).Sqrt;
        return CenteredBounds(e.Center, ex, ey, ez);
    }
```

    // TIGHT: the torus is the major circle Minkowski-summed with a ball of the minor
    // radius, so its support along a world axis is the circle's support
    // R*sqrt(1 - (axis.e)^2) plus r.
    Bounds(t: Torus): Bounds3D
    {
        var e = DiskHalfExtents(t.Axis.Vector, t.MajorRadius);
        return CenteredBounds(t.Center,
            e.X + t.MinorRadius, e.Y + t.MinorRadius, e.Z + t.MinorRadius);
    }
```
